navigation.note: off preserves existing prompts. Set on only after checking map coverage for the target repository; map entries are navigation hints, never source authority.

routines_note: demo routines (readme-doc-fixes, perf-regressions) removed 2026-10-21 for the clean first run; they overrode explicit @priority in inbox files at intake. Re-add deliberately, and decide whether explicit file metadata should win over a keyword routine.

providers.note: spec 014 launch boundary: per-role override, e.g. "by_role": { "sage": "claude" }; custom CLIs/models live under catalog. Discovery validates PATH before any preview/launch; a missing executable blocks the run with an actionable message.

codex_bridge.note: opt-in app-server bridge; link one explicit Codex thread before enabling

github.note: leftover from the 2026-10-20 intake test; repo is private and gh is unauthenticated. Re-enable only after gh auth login (or GITHUB_TOKEN), otherwise intake 404s.

azure.note: set enabled=true and provide AZDO_PAT (Work Items: Read). tls_allow_untrusted is ON for the self-hosted server certificate; turn it off if you install a trusted cert.

workspaces.note: put a local clone path in repos.<owner/name>.path to get cheap git worktrees instead of fresh clones
